title: The forecourt under the phone budget, with nothing lost from view
caption: Stage 2 of #372. The forecourt drew most of its trees, paving and shop street whole from every camera and again for the shadows, though a tenth of it was on screen. Big merged meshes are now cut into pieces so what is off screen stops drawing, and shadows come from lighter stand-ins. Phone: 211 draws and 397k triangles before, 192 and 287k after (budget 200 and 300k). Desktop: 522 and 843k before, 464 and 786k after (budget 500 and 800k). The plaza and east lane got lighter too. The pictures are the same cameras before and after; only the pigeons moved.
